scope: Day-level publication-date research and representation analysis for the already accepted non-authoritative Singer 2016 Kindle Evidence identity only.

identity.title: NeuroDiversity: The Birth of an Idea
identity.author: Judy Singer

evidence.finding: Singer identifies NeuroDiversity: The birth of an idea as a 2016 Kindle publication and links the exact Amazon Kindle identity ASIN B01HY0QTEE.
Goodreads identifies a 98-page Kindle Edition of NeuroDiversity: The Birth of an Idea by Judy Singer as published July 3, 2016.

Singer's post dated July 16, 2016 says she had republished the thesis on Kindle with a new introduction. This independently bounds availability to no later than July 16, 2016 but does not state the publication day.
Singer again cites the book as a 2016 Kindle publication and links ASIN B01HY0QTEE, corroborating edition identity but not the day-level date.

negative_and_limit_evidence.assessment: The exact day is supplied by one secondary bibliographic record. First-party sources strongly bind the 2016 Kindle identity and are chronologically consistent with July 3, but do not themselves state that day.

dostoevsky_check.satisfying_story: Goodreads likely reflects Amazon-origin edition metadata, making July 3 look straightforward.
disconfirming_tests: Look for a conflicting day-level date tied to ASIN B01HY0QTEE.
Look for first-party Singer/KDP/Amazon metadata stating a different date.
Keep the 2017 ISBN-bound print identity separate so its September 5, 2017 date cannot contaminate the Kindle identity.
dostoevsky_check.result: No conflict found, but the exact day is not independently day-level corroborated.

assessment.reason: 2016-07-03 remains the best day-level candidate, but current evidence is insufficient to place it unqualified in the v0.2 date field. Owner acceptance cannot increase the evidential certainty of the underlying metadata.

representation_analysis.current_v0_2_constraint: Evidence requires an exact ISO date and provides no date-precision or confidence mechanism.
representation_analysis.known_fact: The Singer Kindle edition is a 2016 publication tied to ASIN B01HY0QTEE.
representation_analysis.unresolved_fact: The exact publication day is not independently verified strongly enough for unqualified use.

routes.description: Obtain stronger first-party or strong catalogue/archive day-level evidence tied specifically to ASIN B01HY0QTEE.
Design a separately reviewed partial or precision-aware date representation that can preserve the known year without asserting unsupported month/day precision.
Retain the Singer 2016 edition unmapped until its date can be represented faithfully.

representation_analysis.preference_reason: Incomplete bibliographic dates are likely to recur, so the inability to represent known-but-inexact dates is a general modelling weakness rather than a Singer-only exception.

decision_candidate.recommended_conclusion: 2016-07-03 remains the best day-level candidate, but current evidence is insufficient to place it unqualified in the v0.2 date field.
decision_candidate.next_protected_question: How should ND Oracle represent a bibliographic date when the publication year is known but exact day-level precision is unresolved?
does_not_authorise: acceptance of 2016-07-03 as an exact publication fact

reopening_conditions: ASIN-bound Amazon or KDP metadata establishes or conflicts with 2016-07-03.
A first-party author record establishes or conflicts with the day-level date.
A stronger contemporaneous catalogue or archival record tied to the same Kindle identity establishes or conflicts with the day-level date.
A separately reviewed precision-aware date design provides a faithful representation of the known year without unsupported day-level precision.
